description: This file contains functions to transform location data from API format to internal format, including mapping of different location types and handling of team locations.

methods.name: transformLocation
methods.description: Transforms a single location object from API format to internal format based on its type.

methods.name: transformLocationsApiToInternal
methods.description: Transforms an array of location objects from API format to internal format.

methods.name: transformTeamLocationsApiToInternal
methods.description: Transforms an array of team location objects from API format to internal format, handling default app case.
